scope: Five actual task entries: ordered startup, queue creation, watchdog state, bounded repeated loop traces, signed-range flag selection, queue drain/record zeroing, motion, suspend, failure faults and storage callback
limitations: Actual synchronization, watchdog/list, current-task getter and source memory bodies execute; heap, mutex, final sample, RTOS, startup and dispatch providers are intercepted.
Loops are observed for two waits, up to three queued records or three indefinite-delay attempts; this does not prove scheduler concurrency or actual hardware.
Actual creators/stoppers are not executed in this oracle; their context references are test-only initial-data bindings.
Original instruction identity and whole-image source completeness remain open.
